description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for editing notes, including classes for passing arguments and returning results, and UI logic for editing, saving, and deleting a note.

classes.name: NoteEditorArguments
classes.description: Holds the arguments passed to the note editor, including the note to edit and a flag indicating if it is a new note.

classes.name: NoteEditorResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of the editing process, including the updated note or deletion flag.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides the UI for creating or editing a note.

methods.name: _saveAndClose
methods.description: Creates an updated Note object and closes the editor, returning the result.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Asks for user confirmation to delete the note, and if confirmed, closes the editor with a delete result.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the text controllers with the current note's data.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers to free resources.

methods.name: build
